result.reason: The redline adds a mutual cap and the preferred uncapped carve-outs while preserving the mutual consequential-damages exclusion. However, it does not state that Customer payment obligations are not damages, as required by the preferred position. It also measures the cap using all “amounts paid or payable between the parties” before the event giving rise to the claim, rather than fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim; this could include non-fee amounts and materially alter the calculation. Because the USD 1,000,000 floor can exceed a pure 12-month-fees cap, the clause does not cleanly match the fallback either. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial intent.
